result.summary: The image depicts a narrow, one-way residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though they are significantly constrained by obstructions. The environment lacks basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps, and the pavement shows signs of wear and unevenness.

result.summary: A narrow residential street with brick row houses, featuring sidewalks on both sides and mature street trees. The roadway contains embedded streetcar tracks and allows for on-street parking, but lacks marked pedestrian crossings.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might step into the street to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of narrow residential streets with brick row houses. While the narrow roadway width naturally limits vehicle speeds, the lack of marked crosswalks, ADA-compliant curb ramps, and significant pavement degradation in the alleyway reduces overall safety and accessibility.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The alleyway surface is cracked, patched, and uneven with numerous utility markings, posing a significant trip hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no sloped transitions from the sidewalk to the street level, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground corner where the sidewalk meets the street.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility box and bollards significantly narrow the usable sidewalk width at the corner.

interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corner to ensure universal accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add painted crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and alert drivers to the crossing point.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the alleyway to eliminate trip hazards and provide a smooth, safe walking surface.
